heading: Saved source coverage - note {number}
shared: These checks share the same saved inventory; occurrences are not added together.
scope: Native inventory scope: main document body; other package parts are not established.
not_recorded: This saved assessment does not confirm whether equations were checked. It is unknown whether the manuscript contains equations or how many.
unavailable: The saved record could not confirm whether equations were checked. It is unknown whether the manuscript contains equations or how many.
unknown: The saved inventory does not establish equation presence and count.
excluded: Text and table content affected by native Word equations was excluded.
unlocated_unknown: The number of equation occurrences without a source position was not recorded.
criterion_omitted: The saved assessment input omitted {count} native Word equation {noun}.
unlocated_limit: The saved source record does not establish that the remaining text and tables could be used safely.
criterion_unread_pages: Pages {pages} could not be read in a reliable order and were left out. This assessment is based on the other pages; check those pages before relying on it.
criterion_images_not_read: Image content was not assessed. Grading reads the manuscript's text, not its images, so anything shown only in a figure, diagram or screenshot was not part of this assessment. Check those images yourself if this criterion depends on them.
originality_reference_list_unconfirmed: Originality and reuse check: no text was compared. When this check ran, the whole text was left out whenever the reference list's entries or end could not be confirmed, as here. This is not evidence of originality. A new check run compares the body text.
